glosa: heredero, el que recibe la porción no como jornal de un día sino como lo que corresponde al hijo
defStrong: a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor
derivacion: from G2819 (κλῆρος) and the base of G3551 (νόμος) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment);
